name: משוואה ריבועית – השלמה לריבוע עם מקדם מוביל (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Solve the following quadratic equation by completing the square: \[ {{CT:0}} = 0. \]
Give the completed square form: [[input:cans]] \(=0\). [[validation:cans]]
[[feedback:comp]]
Give your answer as a set \(\left(\mbox {e.g.}\ \left\{x_1 , x_2\right\} \right)\):

\({{CT:1}} \in \) [[input:ans]] [[validation:ans]][[feedback:prt1]]
generalfeedback:
When solving a more complicated quadratic; a better option, than factorising, is completing the square (The method by which we remove the {{CT:2}} term). The general rule is:

\[ ax^2+bx+c = a\left(x^2+\frac{b}{a}x+\frac{c}{a}x \right) = a\left(\left(x+\frac{b}{2a} \right)^2-\frac{b^2}{4a^2}+\frac{c}{a} = a\left(x+\frac{b}{2a} \right)^2-\frac{b^2}{4a}+c \right). \]

Once you have removed the \(x\) term you can rearrange the formula to find \(\left( x+\frac{b}{2a} \right)^2\). Then you simply need to square root and rearrange to find \(x\).

In this example:

\[ {{CT:0}} = 0, \]

we extract the {{CT:3}} coefficient, \({{CT:4}}\):

\[ {{CT:5}} = 0. \]

Then we complete the square:

\[ {{CT:6}} = 0. \]

Multiply through by \({{CT:4}}\):

\[ {{CT:7}} = 0. \]

Rearranging gives:

\[ {{CT:8}} = {{CT:9}}. \]

Square root (remember to take plus and minus):

\[ {{CT:10}} = \pm {{CT:11}}. \]

Finally:

\[ {{CT:1}} = {{CT:12}} \pm {{CT:13}}. \]

Therefeore, our solution set is:

\[ {{CT:1}} \in \left\{ {{CT:14}} , {{CT:15}}    \right\}. \]
